title: Governed action handoff
objective: Authorize the bounded, fail-closed handoff of one harmless fixed-fixture read from a constrained Moirae host through Horae to Ananke, with Ananke as the sole authority and physical reader.

repositoriesInvolved.name: ananke
repositoriesInvolved.role: action-authority and sole physical fixture reader

repositoriesInvolved.name: horae
repositoriesInvolved.role: fail-closed handoff and typed result relay

repositoriesInvolved.name: moirae-code
repositoriesInvolved.role: constrained request origin and typed result host

repositoriesInvolved.name: adrasteia
repositoriesInvolved.role: portable contract baseline; no change approved

contractChanges: None; no Runtime Contracts package or protocol change is approved for Slice 02.
requiredConsumerTests: Ananke: strict action/argument/context/policy validity, zero-read denial, one physical read, digest mismatch and audit count.
Horae: registration/startup race, readiness freshness, compatibility, endpoint/capability drift, dispatch, relay, timeout and indeterminate preservation.
Moirae Code: unsupported action, no direct Ananke fallback, no local fixture read, typed result presentation and bypass limitations.
Adrasteia: retain the current contract/protocol baseline without a package or protocol change.
integrationTests: Positive completed read with exactly one Ananke read.
Denied zero-read, malformed extra-argument and digest-mismatch cases.
Principal, scope, purpose and policy mutation cases.
Stale readiness, startup race, incompatible protocol and identity/endpoint drift cases.
Schema/origin mutation, timeout and indeterminate post-dispatch-loss cases.
No direct Moirae-to-Ananke fallback and no non-Ananke fixture read.
One real three-process positive and negative proof; mocks cannot satisfy route evidence.
deferredWork: Governed execution beyond the fixed fixture.
Qualified Mnemosyne context retrieval and memory handoff.
Durable idempotency, persistence, retry, reconciliation and recovery.
Content preflight, provider fallback, credentials, browser, shell, workflow and global host governance.
stopConditions: Do not advance any component checkpoint or tag out of order.
Do not advance fates-lock.json, compatibility-matrix.json, the Stage-A snapshot or any seal claim before all required producer and cross-runtime evidence is accepted.
Stop if the route requires a mock transport, direct or alternative Ananke path, unbound origin/schema/readiness evidence, or any excluded capability.
Retain the provisional Moirae checkpoint disclosure until a verified annotated tag exists.
